turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani futhi. Siyanamukela futhi kwi-module ekhuluma ngolwazi magama.
turns.en: Hello again. We welcome you again to the module that talks about vocabulary.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kule module, sizokhuluma kabanzi ngokubaluleka kokuthuthukisa ulwazi magama ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda, ukukhuluma kanye nokubhala.
turns.en: In this module, we will talk in detail about the importance of developing vocabulary so that learners are able to read, speak and write.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ingxenye enkulu ye-module ibhekene nokuchaza indima edlalwa ulwazi magama ekufundiseni ukufunda.
turns.en: A large part of the module deals with explaining the role played by vocabulary in teaching reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda le module, uzokwazi ukuhlela izigaba ezahlukene zamagama,
turns.en: After completing this module, you will be able to organize different categories of words,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukuchaza indima edlalwa wulwazi magama uma ufunda,
turns.en: to explain the role played by vocabulary when reading,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukuhlela imisebenzi yabafundi abazoyenza uma ufundisa ulwazi magama,
turns.en: to organize activities for learners to do when you teach vocabulary,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: nokuchaza amasu ahlukene okuthuthukisa ulwazi magama.
turns.en: and to explain different strategies to develop vocabulary.
